research_objective: Prospectively discriminate MF2 versus MF4 actionable frequency, exclusive behavior, and later outcome quality without adapting the policy to observed outcomes.
eligibility_rule: all integrity, temporal, coverage, actionable, and discriminative gates must pass simultaneously

collection_coverage.denominator: contracted 15-minute cycles multiplied by symbols in the frozen schedules

actionable_sample.definition: union of shared, MF2-only, and MF4-only actionable canonical observations
actionable_sample.derivation: rounded above 385, the worst-case Bernoulli sample size for an approximately 95% interval with 5 percentage-point margin of error

discriminative_sample.definition: canonical observations where exactly one design is actionable
discriminative_sample.derivation: approximately 175 observations per independent exclusive subgroup to detect a 15 percentage-point difference around a 50% baseline with two-sided alpha 0.05 and power 0.80
